scope: Independent Git-blob byte comparison; only import module paths and the explicit axiom-audit module-name registry may differ. Does not rerun Lean or native Tex2Lean.
limitations: Source-level comparison does not assert byte-identical elaborated terms; relocated private declarations can acquire different generated names.
Current strict Lean checks must be run by integration owner after final edits.
Immutable native receipts remain historical and are not certificates for the relocated tree.
